description: This file implements serialization, deserialization, and utility functions for 'capsule' data structures used in the quiche library, including capsule type conversions, string representations, and parsing logic for various capsule types related to WebTransport and IP address management.

classes.name: WirePrefixWithId
classes.description: Helper class for serializing PrefixWithId structures into wire format.

classes.name: WireIpAddressRange
classes.description: Helper class for serializing IpAddressRange structures into wire format.

methods.name: CapsuleTypeToString
methods.description: Converts CapsuleType enum to string representation.

methods.name: Capsule::Datagram
methods.description: Creates a Capsule object with a datagram payload.

methods.name: Capsule::LegacyDatagram
methods.description: Creates a Capsule object with a legacy datagram payload.

methods.name: Capsule::LegacyDatagramWithoutContext
methods.description: Creates a Capsule object with a legacy datagram without context payload.

methods.name: Capsule::CloseWebTransportSession
methods.description: Creates a Capsule object representing a WebTransport session close event.

methods.name: Capsule::Unknown
methods.description: Creates a Capsule with an unknown type and payload.

methods.name: Capsule::ToString
methods.description: Returns string representation of a Capsule.

methods.name: CapsuleParser::IngestCapsuleFragment
methods.description: Ingests a fragment of capsule data for parsing.

methods.name: CapsuleParser::AttemptParseCapsule
methods.description: Attempts to parse a capsule from buffered data.

methods.name: CapsuleParser::ReportParseFailure
methods.description: Reports a parse failure to the visitor.

methods.name: CapsuleParser::ErrorIfThereIsRemainingBufferedData
methods.description: Checks for remaining buffered data and reports error if incomplete.

methods.name: ReadWebTransportStreamId
methods.description: Reads a WebTransport stream ID from the data reader.

methods.name: ParseCapsulePayload
methods.description: Parses capsule payload based on capsule type.
